mapper.select: SELECT a.*, h.hongniang_name, h.avatar AS hongniang_avatar, h.level AS hongniang_level FROM xiangqin_activity a LEFT JOIN hongniang_info h ON a.hongniang_id = h.id WHERE a.hongniang_id = #{hongniangId} ORDER BY a.create_time DESC
